description: This file contains functions and logic for fetching and displaying chess game data from external APIs (Chess.com and Lichess), managing UI interactions for game selection, and handling date periods for game retrieval.

methods.name: padMonth
methods.description: Pads a month number with a leading zero if necessary.

methods.name: updateGamesPeriod
methods.description: Updates the display of the current game period (month/year).

methods.name: getPlayersString
methods.description: Generates a string describing the players in a game, including AI levels if present.

methods.name: generateGameListing
methods.description: Creates a DOM element representing a game listing with click event to load PGN.

methods.name: fetchChessComGames
methods.description: Fetches games from Chess.com API for a given username and populates the UI.

methods.name: fetchLichessGames
methods.description: Fetches games from Lichess API for a given username and populates the UI.

methods.name: fetchGames
methods.description: Determines which API to call based on selected load type.

methods.name: closeModal
methods.description: Closes the game selection modal and resets the game period to current date.

methods.name: registerModalEvents
methods.description: Registers event handlers for modal buttons and navigation.

methods.name: onFetchButtonClick
methods.description: Handles the fetch button click, initiates game fetching process.
